reform_history.notes: Alberta established Generic Oil Sands Royalty: 1% of gross revenue pre-payout, 25% of net revenue post-payout. Designed to attract capital for high-cost bitumen extraction. Foundation for 20+ years of oil sands fiscal structure.
reform_history.source: Alberta Department of Energy Generic Royalty Framework 1988; NEB Canada

reform_history.event: New Royalty Framework - higher sliding scale
reform_history.notes: Stelmach government raised oil sands royalties: 1-9% gross, 25-40% net (sliding scale). Triggered investment pause; CNRL, Shell, Imperial deferred projects. NRF partially rolled back in 2011.
reform_history.source: Alberta Department of Energy NRF Implementation 2009; CAPP oil sands review

reform_history.notes: Simpler activity-based pre-payout royalties. Slightly lower effective rate for early-stage projects. Stabilized higher-production royalties.
reform_history.source: Government of Alberta Royalty Review Advisory Panel Report 2016; AER
